upgrade_rules.OBSERVED: A phenomenon is measured above basic sanity/null checks in a specified dataset and measurement regime.
upgrade_rules.REPRODUCIBLE: The same object recurs across predefined runs, sessions, subjects, or equivalent repeated units.
upgrade_rules.OOD_SUPPORTED: The object improves a preregistered out-of-distribution endpoint without changing post-holdout definitions.
upgrade_rules.EXTERNALLY_REPLICATED: The object survives a locked independent dataset using frozen definitions and model rules.

downgrade_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: The preregistered primary gate fails or strong baseline/null remains unbeaten.
downgrade_rules.CONFOUNDED: A plausible competing explanation remains unresolved or performs materially well.
downgrade_rules.DATA_BLOCKED: The required variable/data object is absent; this is not evidence against the hypothesis.
downgrade_rules.TOOLCHAIN_BLOCKED: The required computational route is not complete enough for a scientific hypothesis test.
